title: Anand Bhavan, Prayagraj - Home of India’s Freedom Struggle
content:
Anand Bhavan, Prayagraj

Anand Bhavan is one of the most important historical landmarks in Prayagraj (formerly Allahabad). Once the residence of the Nehru family, this elegant mansion played a crucial role in India’s freedom movement. Today, Anand Bhavan stands as a national museum, preserving the memories, sacrifices, and leadership that shaped modern India.

For history lovers and students, a visit to Anand Bhavan offers a deep and inspiring glimpse into India’s past.

History of Anand Bhavan

Anand Bhavan was originally built in the early 20th century by Motilal Nehru, a prominent lawyer and freedom fighter. When the Indian independence movement gained momentum, Motilal Nehru donated the earlier family home, Swaraj Bhavan, to the nation. Anand Bhavan then became the new residence of the Nehru family.

It served as the home of Jawaharlal Nehru, India’s first Prime Minister, and Indira Gandhi, India’s first woman Prime Minister. Many important meetings of the Indian National Congress were held here, making it a nerve center of the freedom struggle.

Architecture & Museum Highlights

Anand Bhavan is a beautiful blend of colonial and Indian architectural styles.

Inside the Museum, Visitors Can See:

  • Personal belongings of Jawaharlal Nehru
  • Rooms used by Indira Gandhi
  • Photographs, letters, and documents related to the freedom movement
  • Original furniture, books, and household items
  • A section dedicated to Motilal Nehru
  • Each room tells a story of leadership, simplicity, and dedication to the nation.

Planetarium at Anand Bhavan

The Jawahar Planetarium, located inside the Anand Bhavan complex, is a major attraction, especially for children and students. It offers educational shows on astronomy and space science, making the visit both informative and engaging.

Gardens & Surroundings

The mansion is surrounded by well-maintained gardens and lawns, creating a peaceful atmosphere. Visitors can walk around, relax, and reflect on the historic events that once took place here.

Location & How to Reach

  • Anand Bhavan is located in Civil Lines, Prayagraj.
  • By Road: Easily accessible by auto, cab, and city buses
  • By Train: Prayagraj Junction (5 km)
  • By Air: Prayagraj Airport (12 km)

Timings & Entry Fee

Timings:

  • Museum: Usually 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM (Closed on Mondays)
  • Planetarium: Shows at fixed timings

Entry Fee:

  • Indians: Nominal fee (around ₹20-₹25)
  • Foreigners: Higher fee
  • Planetarium: Separate ticket

(Timings and fees may change.)

Best Time to Visit

  • October to March: Pleasant weather
  • Morning hours: Less crowded and peaceful

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Swaraj Bhavan
  • Allahabad Museum
  • Khusro Bagh
  • Triveni Sangam
  • All Saints Cathedral

faqs.question: Why is Anand Bhavan famous?
faqs.answer: It is famous as the residence of the Nehru family and a center of India’s freedom movement.

faqs.question: Is Anand Bhavan different from Swaraj Bhavan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Swaraj Bhavan was the original family home, while Anand Bhavan became the new residence later.

faqs.question: Is photography allowed inside Anand Bhavan?
faqs.answer: Photography is generally restricted inside museum rooms.

faqs.question: How much time is required to explore Anand Bhavan?
faqs.answer: Around 1 to 1.5 hours is enough for the museum and gardens.

faqs.question: Is Anand Bhavan suitable for children?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially with the planetarium, it is educational and engaging for children.
